subject.en: Less modeling from scratch for your next game update
subject.zh: 下一版游戏，让团队少从零建模

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

For the next game update, could your artists start some props from generated models? They would have a model to refine, instead of building every shape by hand.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your game team a way to start that work:
• Generate an initial 3D model from text or a reference image.
• Take the model into the tools your artists already use and refine it for the game.

The aim is less time spent on initial modeling, with your artists still deciding what meets the project's requirements. Whether it saves work depends on the edits needed afterward.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Compare the total work needed for approved props, not just the time to generate a model.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏需要的道具，有没有一部分可以让您的美术团队从生成模型开始做？先有模型再修改，不必每个造型都从零搭建。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 可以帮助游戏团队开始这部分制作：
• 从文字或参考图生成初版 3D 模型。
• 把模型放进美术熟悉的工具，再按游戏要求继续精修。

目的是少花一些初版建模的时间，是否符合项目要求仍由您的美术团队决定。实际能省多少工作，要把后续修改也算进去。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。比较道具做到验收通过所需的总投入，而不只是生成模型的速度。

followup.en:
For this pilot, the useful question is how much initial modeling your team can avoid without adding more work later.

The proposed comparison would use 10 props or characters from your real game project. It would cover the time to a first useful model, generation and retry costs, then cleanup, review and the work needed to get the asset into your engine. Unsuccessful attempts count too.

That gives you a cost and time per approved asset to compare with your current process. A fast first result is not a saving if it needs more repair than the alternative.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree on the asset list, acceptance criteria, who performs the checks and which records can be supplied. Your team keeps final approval. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
这次试点主要看一件事：能不能少做一些初版建模，又不把省下的工夫变成后续更多的修改。

建议选您实际游戏项目里的 10 个道具或角色做对照。比较首个可用模型所需的时间、生成和重试费用，再加上清理修改、审核以及接入游戏引擎的工作。失败的尝试也计入成本。

这样就能与现有流程比较，每个通过验收的资产实际花了多少工时和费用。如果后面需要更多修复，初版出得快也不代表总投入更少。

开始前，您的团队需与 Tripo 确认资产清单、验收要求、谁执行检查，以及能够提供哪些记录。最终验收权仍在您的团队。试点范围、是否可安排、使用权限和费用均需确认。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

subject.en: Can generated props meet your game's requirements?
subject.zh: 生成的道具，能不能达到您游戏的要求？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

A generated chest may look right in a preview. What will your team need to change before it works in the next game update? That's the part worth testing before adopting it.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, your artists can follow the model through the work that comes after generation:
• Create a starting model from text or a reference image.
• Continue refining it in their existing tools, then check the result in the game engine.

Your team's art direction and technical requirements still decide whether the prop is usable. A generation finishing does not mean the asset has passed those checks.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Find out which props meet your standards, and what it takes to get them there.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

生成的宝箱在预览里看着不错，放进下一版游戏之前，您的团队还需要改哪些地方？是否采用这种做法，值得先把这一步试清楚。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，您的美术团队可以从生成模型继续完成后面的制作：
• 从文字或参考图生成初版模型。
• 在现有工具里继续精修，再放进游戏引擎检查结果。

道具能不能用，仍按团队的美术风格和技术要求判断。生成完成，并不代表已经通过这些检查。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。看看哪些道具能达到项目标准，以及做到这一步还需要多少工作。

followup.en:
The treasure-chest walkthrough is a useful example of what happens after generation: artist refinement, material work and an opening interaction. It is a Studio demonstration, not proof that every generated prop is ready for a game.

For a proposed 10-asset pilot, your team's acceptance checklist would come first. Depending on each prop, that can cover topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, formats, rigging and the result in the engine.

The comparison would include the work needed to meet those requirements: generation and failed retries, cleanup, review, engine checks and any work to fit the result into your tools. The useful result is the total cost per approved asset, plus a clear view of which assets did not pass.

Before starting, agree which evaluation support Tripo can provide, which checks your team will run and what evidence can be supplied. Your team keeps final approval; scope, access, availability and fees need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
宝箱制作示例可以帮助团队看清生成之后的工作：美术精修、材质制作和开箱交互。这是 Studio 演示，不代表每个生成道具都已经能用于游戏。

建议的 10 个资产试点，先从您团队的验收清单出发。按各个道具的用途，检查拓扑、面数、UV、材质、格式、需要时的绑定，以及引擎里的结果。

比较时要把达到这些要求所需的投入算全：生成与失败重试、清理修改、审核、引擎检查，以及接入现有工具的工作。最终看每个通过验收的资产总成本，也要记录哪些资产没有通过。

开始前，先确认 Tripo 能提供哪些评测支持、哪些检查由您的团队完成，以及能提供什么证据。最终验收权仍在您的团队；试点范围、使用权限、是否可安排和费用需先确认。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。

subject.en: Game props your team can find and reuse

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

For the next game update, your artists may need a prop a colleague has already generated. Being able to find that model themselves means one less file request, and less reason to make the same starting model again.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your team a shared place for that work:
• Models generated in team mode go into the team library.
• Members can find shared assets within the access settings your team chooses.
• Suitable models stay available for teammates to reuse as a starting point.

Your artists still check whether an existing model fits the new use. Sharing it does not make it approved for every scene.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. See whether a shared library cuts repeated modeling and file handoffs in your game workflow.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

制作下一版游戏时，您的美术可能会用到同事已经生成过的道具。能自己找到模型，就少一次索要文件，也少一些重新做相同初版模型的必要。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 为这些成果提供团队共享空间：
• 在团队模式中生成的模型，进入团队资产库。
• 成员按团队设置的访问权限，查找共享资产。
• 合适的模型可以保留下来，供其他成员作为制作起点复用。

已有模型是否适合新的用途，仍由美术检查。共享并不意味着它在每个场景里都能直接使用。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。看看共享资产库能否减少游戏制作中的重复建模和文件交接。

followup.en:
This pilot would focus on the handoff between people, not just on producing 10 models.

Using 10 real game assets, the proposed check is whether another artist can find a suitable shared model, understand what it is, and continue working without requesting the file again. It would record reuse, repeated modeling, file requests and the time spent organizing access to those assets.

Reuse still needs a project check. Any adjustment, review and engine work belongs in the comparison, along with the original generation, failed retries and cleanup. Compare the total work with your current handoff process, rather than count a reused file as an automatic saving.

Team Plan provides the shared library. How externally refined files return to the shared workflow, and how they are approved, still needs to be arranged through your team's existing process.

Your team and Tripo would agree the scope, roles, records, access, availability and fees before starting. Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
这次试点重点看成员之间如何接着做，而不只是生成 10 个模型。

建议围绕 10 个真实游戏资产，检查另一位美术能不能找到合适的共享模型、知道它是什么，并且不用再索要文件就继续制作。记录实际复用、重复建模、文件请求，以及整理这些资产访问权限的时间。

复用仍需通过项目检查。为新用途做的调整、审核和引擎检查，都要与原先的生成、失败重试和清理修改一起算入比较。最终对照现有交接流程的总投入，而不是把文件复用一次就算作节省。

Team Plan 提供共享资产库。外部工具里精修的文件如何回到共享流程、如何通过验收，仍需按您团队现有的制作流程安排。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Who should be able to see the game assets your team generates with AI? You can give artists their own access and set the workspace's visibility rules, without relying on a shared login.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your administrators specific controls:
• Invite members, adjust roles and remove access when someone leaves.
• Set asset visibility for members, while administrators retain visibility across the workspace.
• View individual usage from the team management page.

Your team still decides how generated assets are reviewed and approved for the game. Workspace access controls do not replace that process.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Check how the access settings fit your team's review responsibilities before using them across a project.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

团队用 AI 生成的游戏资产，哪些成员应该看得到？您可以让美术各自使用自己的访问权限，并设置工作区里的可见范围，不必共用一个登录账号。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 为管理员提供具体控制：
• 邀请成员、调整角色，并在成员离开时移除访问权限。
• 设置成员的资产可见范围；管理员仍能查看整个工作区。
• 在团队管理页查看成员使用情况。

生成资产如何审核、能否用于游戏，仍由您团队的流程决定，工作区权限不能代替这些审核。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。先看看访问设置能否衔接团队的审核分工，再决定是否在项目中扩大使用。

followup.en:
This pilot would test a practical part of AI use: who can access the work, and who is responsible for approving it.

Across 10 game assets, your team could check member invitations, role changes and asset visibility against its own working arrangements. Administrators retain visibility across the workspace; this is not a way to hide assets from team administrators. Individual usage information is also not a complete generation or approval audit trail.

Your team's existing process still needs to cover input rights, asset review, final use and any disclosure requirements. Before the pilot, the proposal needs agreement with Tripo on which records are available, how the team will retain them, and who performs each check. No automatic compliance or approval service is assumed.

The comparison should include the administration and review time, as well as generation, unsuccessful attempts and refinement needed for the 10 assets. This shows the work involved in using the controls, not a guaranteed reduction in risk.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Scope, access, availability, fees and responsibilities need agreement first.
followup.zh:

围绕 10 个游戏资产，您的团队可以按实际分工，检查成员邀请、角色调整和资产可见设置。管理员仍能查看整个工作区，这并不是对团队管理员隐藏资产的方式。成员用量信息也不等于完整的生成或审批审计记录。

输入素材的使用权、资产审核、最终用途和必要披露，仍需由团队现有流程覆盖。开始前，需与 Tripo 确认可以提供哪些记录、团队如何保留这些记录，以及每项检查由谁执行；不能默认已有自动合规或审批服务。

比较时，除了管理和审核时间，也要计入这 10 个资产的生成、失败尝试和精修投入。这样看清的是使用这些控制需要多少工作，不是保证风险一定降低。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

For the next game update, could your artists start some props from generated models? The aim is to give them a first version to work on, leaving more of their time for the changes the game needs.

With Tripo API, your engineering team can add generation to your asset tool:
• Create starting models from text or reference images.
• Return the models to artists for their usual modeling and texture work.

A test with 10 real props would show whether this reduces the work, once cleanup and game checks are included. Your team can judge whether it helps the asset queue before using it more widely.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一次游戏更新需要的道具，有没有一部分可以让美术从生成模型开始做？先有一个初版，再看看能否少花一些从零建模的时间，把精力留给游戏真正需要的修改。

通过 Tripo API，工程团队可以把生成接入自己的资产工具：
• 从文字或参考图生成初版模型。
• 将模型交给美术，继续熟悉的建模和材质工作。

用 10 个真实道具做一次测试，把清理修改和游戏内检查都算进去，看看工时到底有没有减少。再由您的团队判断，这种方式能不能帮助推进待制作清单，是否值得扩大使用。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
To see whether generation helps the asset queue, the proposed test would use 10 props already needed for your game. The comparison is the total work to an approved prop, not the number of models generated.

Your team and Tripo would first agree the briefs and acceptance checklist, who runs the comparison, who records it and what support Tripo can provide.

The engineering team connects text or image requests to Tripo API, tracks the asynchronous tasks and retrieves the models. Artists then refine them in the normal production workflow. The test would record:
• Time to the first useful model, followed by cleanup, materials, review and engine checks.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Adding 3D generation to your asset-creation tool doesn't have to mean building and maintaining a generation model. Your developers can integrate the service and keep their attention on the product your users work in.

Tripo API provides the generation step:
• Submit text or reference images from your tool.
• Check the task status and retrieve the resulting model files.

Your team keeps control of the interface, asset requirements and review process. There is still integration and maintenance work on your side; the difference is that you are connecting to generation rather than developing the underlying model yourself.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Assess the integration effort and ongoing responsibilities before committing to a wider rollout.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

给资产制作工具加入 3D 生成，不一定要自己开发和维护生成模型。您的开发团队可以通过接口接入，把更多精力放在用户实际使用的产品上。

Tripo API 提供其中的生成环节：
• 从您的工具提交文字或参考图。
• 查询任务状态，并取回生成的模型文件。

产品界面、资产标准和审核流程仍由您的团队掌握。接入与维护工作并没有消失，但团队不必为了这个生成环节，从零开发底层模型。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。先看清接入投入和后续维护分工，再决定是否扩大使用。

followup.en:
For your developers, the initial integration is a request, an asynchronous task and a model file returned to your tool. The API quick start shows that path.

A 10-asset test would also cover what a demo leaves out: authentication, failed tasks, retries, file handling and the way results enter your existing review process. Your team would own those parts of the application.

To compare with an internal build, include the integration and maintenance effort, generation charges, failed attempts and any artist cleanup needed for acceptable results. Faster access to a model is useful only if the whole approach fits your product and budget.

Your team and Tripo would agree on the test scope, technical support available, access, fees and responsibilities before starting.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
对开发团队来说，基础接入路径是：提交请求、等待异步任务完成，再把模型文件取回自己的工具。API 快速入门文档展示了这条路径。

10 个资产的测试还应覆盖演示之外的工作：认证、失败任务、重试、文件处理，以及结果如何进入现有审核流程。这些应用侧工作仍由您的团队负责。

与自建方案比较时，需要一起计算接入与维护、生成费用、失败尝试，以及把模型修改到可接受程度的美术投入。能更快拿到模型，还要看整个方案是否符合产品需求和预算。

开始前，您的团队需与 Tripo 确认测试范围、可提供的技术支持、使用权限、费用和双方分工。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

A model can look convincing in a preview and still need work before your team can use it. For your next asset delivery, the useful question is what it takes to meet the actual brief.

Tripo API lets your developers bring generated models into that assessment:
• Create starting models from text or reference images.
• Retrieve the files for your artists to inspect and refine in the 3D tools they already use.

Your team sets the requirements for geometry, materials and file delivery. A completed generation task is not an accepted production asset.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Compare which models meet your standards and how much work each needs before acceptance.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

模型在预览里看着不错，交给团队使用前可能还要改不少。对下一批要交付的资产，值得先看清：做到实际制作要求，还需要多少工作？

您的开发团队可以通过 Tripo API 取回生成模型，再交给美术评估：
• 从文字或参考图创建初版模型。
• 取回文件，让美术在常用的 3D 软件里检查并精修。

几何、材质和文件交付要求由您的团队确定。生成任务完成，不等于资产已经通过制作验收。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。比较哪些模型能达到团队标准，以及验收前各自还需要多少修改。

followup.en:
Start with the acceptance checklist your team already uses for 3D assets. Depending on the intended use, that may cover topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, scale and file formats.

The proposed test would follow 10 real assets from generation through inspection and refinement in your intended tools. Record failed attempts as well as accepted results, including integration and ongoing maintenance work, generation and retry fees, cleanup and review time.

That lets you distinguish a useful starting model from one that costs too much to repair. The result is a comparison of effort per accepted asset, not a claim that every generated file is ready to deliver.

Before starting, agree which evaluation support Tripo can provide, which checks your team will run and what evidence can be supplied.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation.
followup.zh:
测试从您团队现有的 3D 资产验收清单开始。根据实际用途，可以包含拓扑、面数、UV、材质、尺寸和文件格式等要求。

建议跟踪 10 个真实资产，从生成一直到在目标工具中检查和精修。通过与失败的结果都记录，接入与后续维护、生成和重试费用、清理修改和审核时间都纳入比较。

这样能分清哪些模型是值得继续制作的起点，哪些修复投入过高。最终看每个通过验收的资产需要多少工作，而不是认为每个生成文件都能直接交付。

开始前，先确认 Tripo 能提供哪些评测支持、哪些检查由您的团队完成，以及能提供什么证据。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。测试范围、是否可安排、使用权限与费用需先确认。

intro.en:

Tripo API returns task information your developers can connect to your own records:
• A task ID to identify the generation request.
• Task status and the resulting files for your system to retrieve.

Your application can link that information to the artist's edits and your team's approval record. Building and retaining that record is work for your own system, not an automatic API audit service.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Check whether the generation step fits your existing review and record-keeping process before expanding its use.

Your team would also decide what records it needs for input permissions, final use and any applicable disclosure. Those requirements need your own review; a task ID does not establish ownership or compliance.

The test should include the integration and record-keeping work as well as generation, retries, refinement and review costs. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the information available, responsibilities, access and fees.

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

A new level may need crates, furniture and a chest. Could your artists start those props from generated models, then spend their time shaping them for the scene?

Tripo Studio Team Plan lets your game team begin with something to work on:
• Generate a starting 3D model from a written description or reference image.
• Continue in the modeling tools your artists already use, adjusting the shape and materials for the level.

The goal is to reduce the initial modeling work your team does for those props. Your team would still handle refinement and decide which assets pass the game's checks.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. The pilot would compare real level props from the first model through approval, so you can judge the total work against your current process.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

新关卡可能需要木箱、家具和宝箱。您的美术团队能不能从生成模型开始做，再把时间用在按场景要求调整这些道具上？

Tripo Studio Team Plan 可以让游戏团队先有模型，再继续制作：
• 从文字描述或参考图生成初版 3D 模型。
• 在美术熟悉的建模工具里，继续调整适合关卡的造型和材质。

目的是减少这些道具的初版建模工作。后续精修、哪些资产通过游戏检查，仍由您的团队负责。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。试点会用实际关卡里的道具，从初版做到验收，帮助您判断总投入是否比现有流程更少。

followup.en:
A level's prop list gives the pilot a concrete job: produce the starting models the artists actually need, then follow them through to approval.

The proposed pilot would use 10 props from your team's project. It would compare the current way of making them with a generated starting point, including time to the first useful model, generation and retry fees, and failed attempts.

The rest of the work matters just as much: adjusting shape and materials, reviewing the result, moving it into the existing tools and checking it in the game engine. The comparison ends at an approved prop, not at the first attractive preview.

That lets you judge which kinds of props need less total work and which are better left to the current process. Before starting, agree with Tripo on the list, the team's acceptance criteria, available support and records, and who performs each check. Availability, access, scope and fees need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
关卡的道具清单能给试点一个具体任务：先做出美术真正需要的初版模型，再看它们做到验收通过还需要多少工作。

建议从您团队的项目里选 10 个道具，对比现有制作方式与从生成模型起步的方式。记录首个可用模型的时间、生成和重试费用，以及没有成功的尝试。

后面的造型与材质调整、审核、接入现有工具和游戏引擎检查，同样需要算进去。比较到道具通过验收为止，而不是停在第一张好看的预览。

这样，您就能判断哪些道具的总投入更少，哪些仍适合按现有方式制作。开始前，需与 Tripo 确认道具清单、团队验收标准、可提供的支持和记录，以及检查分工。是否可安排、使用权限、具体范围和费用均需确认。

subject.en: From a generated chest to a prop your game can use
subject.zh: 从生成宝箱，到游戏里真正能用的道具

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

For a chest in your next game build, the shape and texture are only part of the job. Your team also needs it to fit the scene and work as expected in the engine.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your artists a generated starting point to take through that process:
• Create the initial model from text or a reference image.
• Refine it in their existing tools, then test it against the project's requirements.

Tripo's chest walkthrough shows the artist work after generation, including materials and an opening interaction. Your team can use it to understand the steps, not as a guarantee that every model will pass.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Find out what it takes to get your own game props ready for approval.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏里的宝箱，造型和贴图只是制作的一部分。您的团队还要让它符合场景，并在引擎里按预期工作。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，美术可以从生成的初版模型开始，继续完成这些步骤：
• 从文字或参考图生成初版模型。
• 在现有工具里精修，再按项目要求检查。

Tripo 的宝箱示例展示了生成后的美术工作，包括材质制作和开箱交互。您的团队可以用它了解制作步骤，但它不代表每个模型都能通过验收。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。看看您自己的游戏道具做到可验收，还需要哪些工作。

followup.en:
The chest example follows one prop through artist work and into a game interaction. For your pilot, the starting point would be your own project's definition of a usable prop.

A proposed set of 10 game assets could be checked in three parts:
• Model and materials: topology, polygon count, UVs and materials against the team's requirements.
• Tool and engine fit: formats, the work needed to bring the prop into the current workflow, and rigging or interaction checks where relevant.
• Final approval: the artist's revisions, review time, failed attempts and the result in the engine.

Generation and retry costs also belong in the comparison. The result should show both the total cost of props that pass and why others did not, so a convincing demo is not mistaken for project readiness.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree which evaluation support and records are available and who carries out the checks. Your team keeps the final decision. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
宝箱示例把一个道具经过美术制作、进入游戏交互的过程展示了出来。您的试点则要从自己项目对“可用道具”的定义出发。

建议用 10 个游戏资产，分三部分检查：
• 模型与材质：拓扑、面数、UV 和材质是否达到团队要求。
• 工具与引擎适配：格式、接入现有流程所需的工作，以及适用时的绑定或交互检查。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Two scenes can need the same crate without needing two separate starting models. When one artist has generated a suitable prop, the next artist should be able to find it and see whether it can be reused.

Tripo Studio Team Plan provides a shared library for that work:
• Models generated in team mode are kept in the team library.
• Teammates can access shared models under the workspace's visibility settings.
• They can use a suitable model as the starting point for another scene.

Your artists still make the changes needed for that scene and approve the result. Reusing a suitable starting model could mean less time asking for files or building the same shape again.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. The pilot would follow how your team shares and reuses props across scenes.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

两个场景都需要同一种木箱，不一定要各做一遍初版模型。一位美术已经生成了合适的道具，下一位就应该能找到它，看看能不能接着用。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 为这些成果提供共享资产库：
• 团队模式中生成的模型，保留在团队资产库里。
• 成员按工作区的可见设置访问共享模型。
• 合适的模型可以作为另一个场景的制作起点。

新场景需要的调整和最终验收，仍由您的美术团队完成。如果能复用合适的初版模型，团队就有机会少花时间索要文件，也少把相同造型做两遍。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。试点会跟踪您的团队在不同场景之间共享和复用道具的实际过程。

followup.en:
A useful reuse test follows a prop from the artist who generated it to a teammate adapting it for another scene.

For 10 real game assets, the proposed pilot would record whether the next artist can locate a suitable shared model and start work without requesting the file again. It would also record the handoffs that still happen, repeated modeling and the time needed to organize access.

The comparison should follow the reused prop through changes, review and engine checks. It should also include generation and retry fees, including costs from unsuccessful attempts, and the work needed to clean up the original model. A model that is easy to find may still need substantial work for a different scene.

Team Plan supplies the shared library. Your existing production process still needs to define how externally refined files return to shared work and how an approved version is identified.

Your team and Tripo would agree the 10 assets, the handoff steps, available records and support before starting. Roles, availability, access and fees also need confirmation.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot.
followup.zh:
有用的复用测试，需要跟着一个道具，从最初生成它的美术，到把它改用于另一个场景的同事。

建议围绕 10 个真实游戏资产，记录下一位美术能不能找到合适的共享模型、不再索要文件就开始工作。同时也记录仍然发生的交接、重复建模，以及整理访问权限花费的时间。

Team Plan 提供共享资产库。外部精修后的文件如何回到共享流程、怎样识别已通过验收的版本，仍需要团队现有制作流程来安排。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

As the artists working on a level change, who still needs access to its generated props? Your team should be able to change access without passing around a shared login or leaving former members in the workspace.

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your administrators a way to manage that:
• Invite artists with their own access to the team workspace.
• Adjust member roles and remove access when the working team changes.
• Set asset visibility for members, while administrators retain visibility across the workspace.

Who approves a prop for the game remains a decision in your team's own process, not an automatic result of giving someone access.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Check the access arrangements alongside how your team makes, reviews and delivers game props.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

参与关卡制作的美术换了，谁还需要访问其中生成的道具？团队应该能调整访问权限，而不是继续共用登录账号，或把已经离开的成员留在工作区里。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 让管理员可以具体管理这些安排：
• 邀请美术，以各自的访问权限进入团队工作区。
• 随制作成员变化调整角色，或移除访问权限。
• 设置成员的资产可见范围；管理员仍能查看整个工作区。

谁来批准道具用于游戏，仍按您团队自己的流程决定，不是给了访问权限就自动获得批准。

立即联系我们，安排您团队的 10 个资产试点。结合游戏道具实际制作、审核和交付的过程，检查成员访问安排。

followup.en:

The proposed checks would cover invitations, role changes, removal of access and asset visibility. Administrators retain visibility across the workspace. Member usage information can support management, but it is not a complete history of generation or approval.

The team would keep its own decisions about input rights, review, disclosure and final use. Before starting, agree with Tripo which records and support are available, how those records will be retained, and which checks each party will perform.

The comparison would include administration and review time alongside generation, failed attempts and refinement for the 10 props. It should show whether the access arrangements work for this production process, not imply that the pilot certifies compliance or removes AI risk.

Contact us today to set up your team's 10-asset pilot. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation first.
followup.zh:

建议检查成员邀请、角色变更、权限移除和资产可见设置。管理员仍能查看整个工作区。成员使用信息可以辅助管理，但不是完整的生成或审批记录。

subject.en: Less first-pass modeling for your next playable level

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

The next playable level needs crates, lamps and furniture. Could your artists start some of those props from generated models, instead of building every shape by hand?

Tripo API lets your developers add that starting point to the team's asset tool:
• Generate an initial model from a text description or reference image.
• Retrieve the file for an artist to refine for the level.

The point is to get some first-pass modeling off the team's list, not to skip the work that makes each prop fit the game.

A 10-asset test would show which props need less work overall, including revisions and engine checks, before you commit more of the level's asset list.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一关需要箱子、灯具和家具。有没有一部分可以让您的美术团队从生成模型开始做，不必每个造型都从零搭建？

通过 Tripo API，开发团队可以把这个制作起点接入自己的资产工具：
• 从文字描述或参考图生成初版模型。
• 取回文件，由美术按这一关的要求继续精修。

目的是少做一些初版建模，不是跳过让道具符合游戏要求的工作。

计划先用 10 个资产做测试，把修改和引擎检查都算进去，看看哪些道具确实少花了工时，再决定是否用于这一关更多的资产。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
For the next playable level, the comparison should end with props your team can approve, not a folder of generated previews.

The proposed test would follow 10 props from that level's asset list. Your artists would use the same briefs and quality requirements as the current process, then record what was usable from the first model and what still needed work.

The comparison would include:
• Initial modeling, cleanup, materials, review and checks in the game's engine.
• Generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts and rejected props.
• The engineering work to retrieve models through the asset tool, plus ongoing maintenance.

That separates a useful starting model from one that costs more to fix than to make another way. The result can inform which types of props to try next; it is not a promise that every asset will take less time.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree the 10 briefs, acceptance checklist, available evaluation support and who performs and records each check. Your team retains final approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Scope, access, availability and fees need confirmation.
followup.zh:
下一关的道具测试，应当比较到团队能够验收为止，而不是得到一批生成预览图就结束。

计划从这一关的资产清单里选 10 个道具，沿用现有流程的需求和质量要求。美术记录初版哪些部分可以继续用，哪些仍需修改。

对比包括：
• 初版建模、清理、材质、审核，以及游戏引擎内的检查。
• 生成和重试费用、失败尝试，以及最终未通过的道具。
• 通过资产工具取回模型的工程接入和后续维护投入。

这样能分清哪些初版确实有帮助，哪些修起来反而不划算，再决定下一批适合尝试什么道具；不能预先保证每个资产都能节省时间。

开始前，您的团队与 Tripo 先确认这 10 个需求、验收清单、可提供的评测支持，以及谁检查、谁记录。最终验收仍由您的团队负责。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。范围、使用权限、是否可安排和费用均需确认。

subject.zh: 下一版游戏，哪些生成道具真正用得上？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

A prop that looks right in a preview still has to work in your game. Before adding generated assets to the next build, your team needs to see what passes its usual checks.

Tripo API gives your developers a generation step to connect to the existing asset tool:
• Generate a starting model from text or a reference image.
• Retrieve the model files for artist refinement and checks in the target game engine.

Your team keeps the acceptance decisions. A completed task does not mean the prop is ready to ship.

The proposed 10-asset test would show which props pass, what needs repair and the total effort involved. That helps you decide which generated props are worth taking into production.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

一个道具在预览里看着不错，放进游戏还得真正能用。下一版准备采用生成资产之前，团队需要知道哪些能通过平时的检查。

通过 Tripo API，开发团队可以在现有资产工具中接入生成这一步：
• 从文字或参考图生成初版模型。
• 取回模型文件，交给美术精修，并在目标游戏引擎里检查。

验收决定仍在您的团队手里。任务完成，不代表道具已经可以随游戏发布。

计划用 10 个资产做测试，看哪些通过、哪些需要修，以及总共投入了多少工作，再帮助您判断哪些生成道具值得进入制作流程。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
The useful result is a clear decision on each prop: approved for this build, needs further work, or not suitable.

For 10 assets needed by a real game project, your team would set the checks before generation begins. Depending on the prop, those can include silhouette, style, topology, polygon count, UVs, materials and file format. Rigging checks apply where the asset needs them. The final check is how the refined asset behaves in the target engine.

The proposed comparison would record:
• The fixes and review steps between the generated file and the team's decision.
• The total time and cost for approved assets, including generation, retries, unsuccessful attempts and artist refinement.
• Engine testing, integration and maintenance work, rather than counting only API charges.

Your team's acceptance standard stays the same throughout. Tripo and your team would agree which evaluation support is available, who runs the checks and who retains the evidence before starting. An API success status is not an acceptance result.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. Scope, availability, access and fees need agreement first.
followup.zh:
有用的测试结果，是每个道具都有一个明确结论：这一版可以采用、还需要修改，或者不适合。

针对实际游戏项目需要的 10 个资产，您的团队在生成前确定检查项。按道具用途，检查轮廓、风格、拓扑、面数、UV、材质和格式；需要绑定的资产再检查绑定。最后要看精修后的资产在目标引擎里是否符合要求。

计划记录：
• 从生成文件到团队作出判断，中间经历了哪些修改和审核。
• 资产通过验收的总工时与成本，计入生成、重试、失败尝试和美术精修。
• 引擎测试、接入与维护工作，不只计算 API 费用。

整个过程中沿用团队原有验收标准。开始前，Tripo 与您的团队确认可提供哪些评测支持、谁执行检查，以及谁保留证据。API 的成功状态不等于验收结果。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。先确认范围、是否可安排、使用权限和费用。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

When an AI-generated prop enters a playable build, can the next reviewer find who approved it and which version they saw? That information should stay with the asset as the game develops.

Tripo API provides task information your developers can connect to your own records:
• Use the task ID to identify the generation job behind a model.
• Retrieve its status and output, then link the saved file to your review record.

Your system would retain the original request, later artist edits and approval history. Those links require your team's development work; the API does not provide a complete audit trail.

A 10-asset test would check whether the records follow the props through your game's review process.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

一个 AI 生成道具进入可玩版本后，下一位审核者能不能查到谁批准了它、当时看的是哪个版本？游戏继续开发，这些信息也应该跟着资产保留下来。

Tripo API 提供任务信息，开发团队可以把它们关联到自己的记录：
• 用任务 ID 对应模型背后的生成任务。
• 取回任务状态和输出，再将保存的文件关联到审核记录。

原始请求、美术后续修改和批准历史，需要在您自己的系统里保留。这些关联由团队开发实现；API 本身不提供完整审计记录。

计划用 10 个资产测试，看看道具经过游戏审核流程时，对应记录能否跟得上。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

followup.en:
For a prop being considered for a game build, the proposed test would check whether a reviewer can identify the generated file, the version an artist refined and the version that was approved.

Tripo API provides a task ID, status and output information. Your developers would save the original request in your own system, retain the retrieved files and connect these to your existing asset records. Later edits, review decisions and build approval are records your team must capture; they do not come from a successful generation task.

With 10 game assets, the test would examine:
• Which links are present between requests, files, revisions and approval, and where information is missing.
• Who retains each record, including failed attempts, retries and rejected props.
• The integration and ongoing maintenance work, plus generation charges, retries, refinement, review and engine checks.

Before starting, agree with Tripo on the information and support available, responsibilities, access and fees. Your team determines its retention, input-rights and disclosure requirements. This test does not certify compliance or resolve asset ownership.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

围绕 10 个游戏资产，测试检查：

• 每项记录由谁保留，包括失败尝试、重试和未通过的道具。
• 接入及持续维护工作，以及生成费用、重试、精修、审核和引擎检查投入。

开始前，与 Tripo 确认可提供的信息和支持、双方分工、使用权限及费用。保存期限、输入素材权利和披露要求，仍由您的团队确定。这项测试不提供合规认证，也不确认资产权属。

立即联系我们，安排您的 10 个资产 API 测试。

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Does the next delivery include a set of chairs, lamps or storage units? Some of that work may suit generated starting models, leaving your artists to handle the details the brief calls for.

Tripo API lets your developers add that option to your asset-production tool:
• Use text or reference images to request initial models.
• Fetch the completed files for your artists to edit in their usual 3D software.

The question is whether this reduces the work for the whole batch. Your team still refines each asset and decides whether it can be delivered.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test. The proposed test would compare the work from the initial brief to approved files, not just how quickly models appear.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一批交付里，是不是有一组椅子、灯具或储物柜要做？其中一些可以考虑从生成模型开始，再由美术处理制作要求里的具体细节。

通过 Tripo API，您的开发团队可以把这种选择加进资产制作工具：
• 用文字或参考图发起请求，生成初版模型。
• 取回完成的文件，让美术在常用的 3D 软件里继续修改。

要看的是整批制作有没有减少工作量。每个资产仍需团队精修，并判断是否符合交付要求。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。拟议测试会比较从制作需求到文件验收通过的总投入，而不只是模型生成得有多快。

followup.en:
The proposed comparison would follow 10 objects from one real delivery brief. Your team would use the same requirements for generated and conventionally modelled assets, so a quick draft is not mistaken for finished work.

For each object, the test would record the time to a useful starting shape, then the editing, materials, file checks and review needed before acceptance. Generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, integration and ongoing maintenance would also be included.

That gives you a view of the whole batch: which objects required less initial modelling, which needed too much repair, and the total effort per accepted asset. The test would not assume every object benefits from generation.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree on the 10 objects, acceptance checklist, who runs the comparison and which records and support can be provided. Availability, access and fees need confirmation; your team keeps final approval.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.
followup.zh:
建议用同一份真实交付需求中的 10 个物体做对照。生成模型和原来的建模方法沿用同样的要求，不把快速得到初稿当成已经完成制作。

每个物体都记录拿到可用初版形体所需的时间，再计入验收前的修改、材质、文件检查和审核。生成与重试费用、失败尝试、接入及后续维护也都包含在内。

这样看的是整批资产：哪些少做了基础建模，哪些修复投入过高，以及每个通过验收的资产总共花了多少工作。测试不预设每件物体都适合生成。

开始前，您的团队与 Tripo 需确认这 10 个物体、验收清单、谁执行对照，以及能提供哪些记录和支持。是否可安排、使用权限和费用需先确认，最终验收仍由您的团队决定。

立即联系我们，安排 10 个资产的 API 测试。

A delivery checklist gives this comparison a clear finish line: an asset either meets the agreed requirements or still needs work.

For 10 assets from an upcoming brief, your team would specify the required geometry, topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, scale and file formats, as relevant. The files would then be opened and checked in the intended production tools. Rigging would only be included where the asset calls for it.

The proposed test would record accepted results, fixes and rejected attempts. It would count generation and retry fees, artist refinement, file checks, review, integration and ongoing maintenance. This makes the comparison about the effort per accepted asset, rather than how convincing a preview looks.

Before starting, your team and Tripo would agree which checks each side runs, what evaluation support is available and which records can be supplied. Scope, availability, access and fees need confirmation. Your team makes the final acceptance decision.

Contact us today to set up your 10-asset API test.

This test would start with a revised asset, not just its first generated file. Could a reviewer find the request, the working versions and the decision that allowed the final file into your library?

Across 10 assets, your developers would use API task IDs, status and output links as one part of that record. Your own system would need to retain the original input and connect later artist edits, review comments and acceptance decisions. Those links are application work, not a built-in API audit service.

The proposed comparison would identify missing records and assign responsibility for capturing and keeping them. Your team would set its requirements for input permissions, retention, disclosure and final use; a task ID does not establish rights or compliance.

Include the integration and ongoing record-maintenance effort, generation and retry fees, unsuccessful attempts, refinement and review in the test costs. Before starting, agree with Tripo on available information and support, responsibilities, availability, access and fees.
